Before discarding, ask a teammate for a rank pin instead. (2) Discard only when a card is certainly dead, or stuck with 0 signals. (3) Never play a slot with 2+ possible ranks unless the teammate signal pins it; I got lucky twice on guesses. (4) Signals I spent on known touches (e.g. "2" to A04 early) were fine, but keep the last one for a playable pin. Suggested brain v3 = v2 plus: 'check whether a teammate can pin a playable card before discarding; a card that is the only copy of a still-needed rank is never a discard.'

Team message from A02: A02 retro game 2 (19/35). Agree with A04 and A01. My own mistakes: (1) I discarded Violet 3 at turn 9 to get a signal back, while Violet 2 was still in my hand, so the tower stalled; a rank pin would have been better. (2) My last discard was a 1-of-2 gamble; hand-deduction made it cheap, but only when the hand is fully known.
